payload.claim: `ESCALATE` and `PUSHED` are the two line prefixes `publish_finish` emits, and `SA-0170`'s future `gh stack link` decides whether to treat a finish as pushed solely by checking that a line starts with `PUSHED`. Every assertion in `tests/test_finish.py` builds its expected string with `f"{PUSHED}..."` or `f"{ESCALATE}..."`, i.e. it re-imports the same symbol rather than comparing against the literal text `"pushed "` / `"escalate: "`, and `tests/test_cli.py`'s publish-wiring test replaces `publish_finish` entirely so it never touches the real constants either. Changing `PUSHED = "pushed "` to any other string (e.g. `"shipped "`) leaves every test in this diff green, even though it silently breaks the exact contract `SA-0170` is specified to depend on.
